riders.title: Riders
riders.description: Rider profiles with their vehicle and verification status
riders.search: Search by name, phone or rider ID

detail.documents_desc: Review each document right here. Riders on a bicycle only need their national ID.

request.title: Request new verification
request.intro: {name} will have to upload the selected documents again.
request.reason_placeholder: e.g. Your insurance has expired, please upload the new certificate
request.warning_offline: {name} will go offline and can't take orders until staff approve the new documents.
request.note_neutral: {name} will be asked to upload these documents again and staff will review them.

errors.note_required: Add a reason so the rider knows what to upload.
errors.note_too_long: The reason is too long ({max} characters max).
errors.not_required: One of the selected documents isn't required for this rider's vehicle. Reload and try again.
errors.not_found: This rider no longer exists. The page was refreshed.
errors.documents_conflict: The rider's documents changed while you were sending. The page was refreshed, so check and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Blink Server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Your staff role isn't allowed to request verifications.
errors.conflict: The rider's documents changed. The page was refreshed, so check and try again.
errors.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
